## Core Services & Specializations

### 1. High-Retention Short-Form Content
- Engineered specifically for scroll culture (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok).
- Strategic hook framing in the first 3 seconds, dynamic camera punches, seamless speed ramps, and layered SFX impact packs.
- Stylized, kinetic animated captions designed for maximum viewer engagement and algorithmic retention.

### 2. Motion Design & After Effects Mastery
- Custom 2D/2.5D visual graphics bridging footage and art direction.
- 2.5D photo-to-video depth mapping and parallax cinematography using camera projections in Adobe After Effects.
- Kinetic typography, logo reveals, custom stinger transitions, and visual VFX cleanups.

### 3. DaVinci Resolve Studio Color Grading
- Node-based precision color science in DaVinci Resolve Studio.
- Film print emulation (Kodak/Fuji grain and halation), clean skin-tone isolation, contrast curve balancing, and multi-camera color matching.
- Multi-format delivery in Rec.709, sRGB, and theater-ready profiles.

### 4. Commercial & Event Post-Production
- Multi-camera synchronization and narrative assembly for corporate inaugurations, festival recaps, wedding/engagement stories, and brand promos.
- Immersive sound design: atmospheric room tone, foley layering, bass drops, and acoustic audio sweetening.
